title: GSE causal circular exit-set process zero-training readiness
purpose: Prove a joint cardinality and normalized continuous circular exit-set interface before any new training is allowed.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training C01-C08 set-process readiness; no optimizer, checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated best-method choices and continuous execution without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed V2 local-peak failure and oracle-count attribution.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective derived targets.

worlds.selection: Exact S01-S10 x C07 and C08: 20 development worlds; no fitting or selection occurs in readiness.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Audit every reference/join and deterministically select eight unique rows covering cardinality 1-4, wrap, invalid width and both partitions. No resampling, fitting, augmentation or thresholding.

teacher.source: Exact circular exit center/residual/width/profile Teacher plus local axis and width/height/slope/curvature masks.
teacher.use: Presence centers define one normalized permutation-invariant set likelihood and cardinality target; geometry masks are unchanged. Identity and pose are excluded.
teacher.valid_mask: Set centers all valid; width independent; residual/profile exact centers; global geometry four-value mask.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No node/edge/graph is created; future edges remain physical-traversal-only.

split.fit: All 60 fit worlds audited; deterministic batch includes fit rows.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V2 outputs establish failure provenance but are not model inputs; readiness reads only frozen C01-C08 source/Teacher arrays.

methods.main: Five-frame circular backbone with one normalized 180-bin finite-set intensity, explicit 1-4 cardinality, continuous residual/geometry, permutation-invariant set likelihood and count-conditioned threshold-free decode.
methods.baseline: Frozen V2 independent local-peak strict AP 0.110522/0.097221 with no safe threshold; no performance baseline rerun.
methods.fallback: Any population, causality, set ordering, near-exit separation, rotation, finite-backward or hidden-input failure stops before training.

acceptance.population: 80 worlds, 188126 observations, 396913 exits and exact cardinality counts.
acceptance.causality: All five-frame references contiguous and source-equal; Teacher excludes sensor and identity arrays.
acceptance.interface: 769784 parameters, scans-only, zero free queries, normalized set mass, 1-4 count and no existence threshold.
acceptance.set_contract: Correct set has lower NLL than one-bin shift, duplicate or ghost; correct count lower than wrong; wrap and bins two apart decode distinctly.
acceptance.equivariance: 40-column input roll gives 10-bin intensity roll, invariant count/global fields, rotated axis and max error <=3e-5; batch permutation and repeat deterministic.
acceptance.loss: Real 1-4 exit batch outputs, set/cardinality/geometry losses and all gradients finite.

failure_policy: Fail closed without changing cardinality, suppression radius, loss weights, rows, data or tolerances; preserve failure for redesign.
retention: Retain summary, row table, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, log, environment, RUN_STATE and seal; no checkpoint.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only full reference audit and eight-row forward/backward
